title: Records carry evidence trust and file anchors, and preferences come only from the operator
body:
Source: .krn/runs/research/sector-sweep-1119/report.md "S4 Formats & memory"; for t-pvynhpa.
Outcome: harvest ranks operator corrections above CI red and does not filter to failures; preference records only from operator-correction evidence; tool/web-derived records capped at fact with a trust ceiling per evidence kind; records may carry anchors {path, blob_sha} and become stale-candidate when the blob changes; consolidation only proposes trial records, never activates (Anthropic components-of-agent-memory, arXiv 2607.20668, 2607.22157, 2611.22697).
Proof: `node --test test/brain/evidence-trust.test.ts` passes, covering preference-from-operator-only, trust ceiling and blob-anchor staleness.
